// Positive control (#5170): a hand-rolled branch on `kind === 'unreadable'` that returns a pass-shaped verdict.
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  const plan = readTextEvidence(planPath);
  if (plan.kind === 'unreadable') return gateVerdict('advisory', false, { reason: plan.reason });
  switch (plan.kind) {
    case 'none':
      return gateVerdict('skip', false, {});
    default:
      return gateVerdict('pass', false, {});
  }
}
